items.headline: ₹2,459-cr. Ponzi scheme: ED files prosecution complaint
items.blurb: The Enforcement Directorate filed a prosecution complaint before the III Additional District and Sessions Judge, Mangaluru, on Friday seeking conviction of Shivananda, associates and M/s Shivan Associates in a ₹2,459-crore money laundering case linked to a Ponzi scheme probed after a Malappuram police FIR.

items.headline: Khader asks officials to prepare presentation ahead of High Court panel's visit
items.blurb: Dakshina Kannada in-charge Minister U.T. Khader asked Deputy Commissioner H.V. Darshan to ready a checklist of infrastructure needed for a permanent High Court bench as a three-member judicial panel visits Mangaluru; he said Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar supports the bench.

items.headline: Navaratri celebrations off to grand, colourful note
items.blurb: Mangaluru Dasara began at Sri Gokarnanatha Temple, Kudroli, with Navadurga idol installation, Alpana art, processions and Huli Vesha performances on the first day.

items.headline: MUDA chairman inspects sites for cricket stadium
items.blurb: MUDA Chairman Sadashiv Ullal inspected sites including Bangra, Bondel, Mullur, Kannuru and Kenjar for a well-equipped cricket stadium sought by the Karnataka State Cricket Association.

items.headline: 1,128 passengers take KSRTC Dasara package tours on launch day
items.blurb: KSRTC Mangaluru Division’s special Dasara package tours carried 1,128 passengers on launch day from Bejai bus stand to temples and tourist destinations.

items.headline: Fifth edition of Uchila Dasara begins
items.blurb: Dakshina Kannada Deputy Commissioner Swaroopa T.K. flagged off the fifth Uchila Dasara Mahotsava at Uchila Mahalakshmi Temple, Padubidri.

items.headline: Dasara celebrations begin; CM postpones visit to Mangaluru and Udupi
items.blurb: Navaratri began along the coast with Kudroli Gokarnanatha Temple events and traditional Huli Vesha performances; Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar postponed a scheduled visit to Mangaluru and Udupi.

items.headline: KSRTC operates 25 buses under 10-day Dasara Darshan tour package
items.blurb: KSRTC ran 25 buses on a 10-day Dasara Darshan package from Mangaluru and Udupi to temples across the region, using BS-VI fleet buses; 1,028 passengers travelled on the first day.

items.headline: SDPI warns of siege at Belthangady over form-7 misuse claims
items.blurb: SDPI's Sa Kadambu warned of gheraoing the Belthangady tehsildar's office unless authorities act on alleged Form-7 misuse under SIR; a march from Santekatte demanded transparent voter-list revision and action on false applications.

items.headline: MAHE V-C Ramdas Pai gets FICCI award
items.blurb: Manipal Academy of Higher Education chancellor Dr. Ramdas M. Pai received the FICCI Legendary Institution Builder Award 2020 at a ceremony where former Union Minister Murali Manohar Joshi presented the honour.

items.headline: Over 340 acres of forest converted into revenue land in Kolar dist
items.blurb: An Assistant Commissioner’s order converting over 340 acres of forest into revenue land in Kolar district, including the Abbi Mini Forest area, could legalise encroachments, the report said.

items.headline: Gavi Mutt seer calls upon people to preserve legacy of harmony
items.blurb: Koppal Gavi Mutt pontiff Gaviddeshwara Swamy inaugurated Mysuru Dasara, recalling Wadiyars’ contributions, with CM D.K. Shivakumar and ministers present.

items.headline: Grand start to Dasara
items.blurb: Mysuru Dasara opened with ceremonies at Chamundeshwari temple atop Chamundi Hill, with Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar and a pontiff among those present.

items.headline: Three killed, nine injured as lorry rear-ends tractor
items.blurb: Three people were killed and nine injured when a lorry rear-ended a tractor carrying a Durga Devi idol on NH-48 near Hukkeri, Belagavi district.

items.headline: B’luru sees first grassroots protest against new flyovers
items.blurb: Residents held a human-chain protest against the Raghupathi–Kanakapura Main Road elevated corridor project under B-SMILE in Bengaluru.

items.headline: SC: No illegal detention, ensure net not disrupted
items.blurb: The Supreme Court, amid anti-CEC protests in New Delhi, sought normal metro operations and directed that there be no illegal detention and that internet services not be disrupted; around 200 people were detained on Sunday, with notice to the Centre in a contempt plea.

items.headline: Detentions don’t deter protesters; bigger mobilisation likely today
items.blurb: Detention of Constitutional Justice Party protesters in Delhi did not stop the stir; INDIA bloc leaders including Mallikarjun Kharge and Rahul Gandhi planned to march to the Supreme Court with a memorandum for the CJI.

items.headline: Give priority to Godavari-Cauvery interlinking: Vijay to PM
items.blurb: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister C. Joseph Vijay, at Chennai project launches worth over ₹13,000 crore with PM Modi, sought priority for Godavari–Cauvery interlinking and an interstate Hosur–Bengaluru metro corridor.

items.headline: Starlink competition will benefit Indian consumers: Musk
items.blurb: Elon Musk said Starlink’s entry and competition would benefit Indian consumers versus existing players.

items.headline: GST overhaul: Lighter penalties, more certainty
items.blurb: Prabhakar K.S. outlined GST Council changes including lighter penalties, registration reforms, late-fee waivers, faster refunds and a higher arrest threshold of ₹5 crore.

items.headline: Pope to be operated on for lump on lung
items.blurb: Pope Leo XIV was scheduled for surgery for a lung lump at Gemelli Hospital.

items.headline: Indian among 13 killed in attack on Saudi’s Riyadh airport
items.blurb: An Indian was among 13 killed in a drone attack on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airport, attributed to Houthi rebels.

items.headline: 72 killed in airstrike on gold mine on Sudan-Egypt border
items.blurb: An Egyptian military aircraft strike on a gold mine on the Sudan–Egypt border killed 72 people, the report said.

items.headline: Nepal flash floods sweep away houses, five people missing
items.blurb: Flash floods in central Nepal swept away houses after debris blocked a river, with five people missing.

items.headline: Russia, Ukraine agreed to ‘energy truce’, claims Trump
items.blurb: Donald Trump claimed Russia and Ukraine agreed to an energy truce; Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he was unaware of any such development, as Kyiv targeted Moscow’s tech infrastructure.

items.headline: Abhishek fires with bat before Arshdeep checks the chase
items.blurb: Abhishek Sharma’s 69 and Arshdeep Singh’s three wickets paved the way for India’s 14-run win over West Indies in the third T20I at Indore; India led the five-match series 2–1.

items.headline: Smaran holds Karnataka together
items.blurb: Stand-in skipper Smaran R scored 125 as Karnataka posted 274 all out against Andhra in the Ranji Trophy opener in Bengaluru; Andhra were 16/2 at stumps.

items.headline: It's two in two for Verstappen
items.blurb: Max Verstappen won the Singapore Grand Prix, with Charles Leclerc second and Lewis Hamilton third.

items.headline: New Zealand name split ODI squad for India series
items.blurb: New Zealand named a split ODI squad for the India series from November 4, with Rachin Ravindra returning and Tom Latham to captain the first three matches.

items.headline: Menno’s India adventure begins a rollercoaster ride
items.blurb: Dutch defender Menno Koch of Bengaluru FC scored on debut in the 32nd minute against SC Delhi in the ISL.
